environment.backend: Local authoritative handlers with in-memory SQLite/D1 fixture; no production account

procedure: Open the active 3D scene with no investigation panel, focus the viewport and hold W for 12 seconds towards a door until collision stops translation; read renderer data attributes after the continuous sample window.

instrumentation.input: R3F useFrame delta between rendered frames
instrumentation.statistic: Exponential moving average with weight 1-exp(-delta*2), approximately 0.5-second time constant
instrumentation.excluded: Idle/background, non-finite, non-positive and over-120ms frame gaps
instrumentation.sampled_seconds: Sum of accepted frame intervals, not total session or key-hold duration
instrumentation.estimated_fps: 1000 divided by the EMA interval; not GPU time or a full-session average

layout_verification.input: Browser mobile viewport emulation and pointer/keyboard; not physical touchscreen

limitations: No physical-phone GPU or touchscreen measurement was performed.
These two local development samples are not production, low-end hardware or all-eight-case performance benchmarks.
Frame interval EMA is not CPU render duration, GPU timing, loading latency or 1% low frame rate.
No hardware model was recorded; the result cannot represent a specified ordinary-computer configuration.
